name: Steven Mosley
role: Software builder · Developer tools · Interactive experiences
intro: I build software that makes complex work feel more approachable: tools for developers, interfaces with purpose, and interactive experiences worth exploring.
approach: I work from the problem to the finished experience: shaping behavior, reviewing implementation, testing the details, and refining what people actually use. AI is part of my development workflow; design judgment, verification, and ownership stay with me.

projects.name: Void Sector
projects.description: An upcoming, independently developed space MMO built in Godot and C#. Further details will be shared as the project develops.

projects.name: gdh
projects.description: Godot development tooling for Linux. Capture real GPU-rendered scenes, inspect visual output and engine errors, and support agent-driven development with editor integration, tests, and build exports.

projects.name: mdview
projects.description: A terminal Markdown viewer built in Go. Read, search, and follow documents in an interactive pager, or send styled output through a pipeline. Optional Mermaid rendering brings diagrams into Kitty.

projects.name: Claude Plugins
projects.description: My Claude Code plugin marketplace. The issue-board plugin brings GitHub issues, pull requests, acceptance progress, and CI into the working interface. The ask plugin supports side questions and a decision log.
